title: 36 cm. Matched to the neckline.
caption:
36 cm sits at the base of the neck. The neckline decides the rest.

Boat neck, sweetheart, V-neck, collar: four necklines, four pieces, from ₹1,299 to ₹2,300.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ the lengths · 18k gold tone plated · measured, not guessed ]

alt_text: An apricot tile. A small heading reads Maap, written in Marathi, The Measurements, N° 09. Below it, very large dark brown capitals: 36 CM. A gold-tone tennis necklace of clear, crosswise baguette stones lies looped on an ivory organza swatch with pinked edges. Its tail runs off the swatch and under a cream tailor's tape. A gold bracket above the tape marks 0 to 36 centimetres and is labelled 36 cm. A fine gold thread is tied to the gold setting of the last tail stone above the bracket, crosses the bracket, passes under the tape and ends at an ivory hang-tag with an apricot window that reads Shade N° 09, matched to the neckline, crystal, 36 cm. In italics: sits at the base of the neck. At the foot: Baguette Tennis Necklace, Crystal, ₹2,300.

An apricot tile headed The neckline decides. A sage-green line drawing shows a cropped, fitted sari blouse laid flat, seen from the front, with short sleeves that fall close to the body, a dashed centre front with three hooks, and two waist darts. Gold necklace lengths hang from its neck as nested loops at 36, 40 and 50 centimetres, with a Y drop from the 40 ending in a small marquise. A dotted line runs from each to its label, 36 cm, 40 cm, 40 cm plus Y and 50 cm, with the note, in italics: give or take 1 cm. Below is a four-row price list. 36 cm, boat neck: Baguette Tennis Necklace, ₹2,300. 40 cm, sweetheart: Serpentine Whisper Chain, ₹1,299. 40 cm plus Y, v-neck: Marquise Layering Set, ₹1,599. 50 cm, collar: Toggle Link Chain, ₹1,299. At the foot: 18K gold tone plated.

An apricot tile headed [01], 36 cm: Boat neck. 36 cm. Beside the heading, a small sage line drawing of a blouse with a wide, shallow boat neck, and a short gold necklace sitting close above it. A photograph in an ivory border shows a woman's neck and collarbones, cropped below the chin. She wears the gold-tone Baguette Tennis Necklace of clear baguette stones, close at the base of the neck. An ivory hang-tag pinned to the photo's edge reads Shade N° 09, matched to boat neck, crystal, 36 cm. Below: Baguette Tennis Necklace, ₹2,300. In italics: crosswise baguettes, close at the base of the neck. Then: crystal, ruby-red or green.

An apricot tile headed [02], 40 cm: Sweetheart. 40 cm. Beside the heading, a small sage line drawing of a blouse with a sweetheart neckline, two rounded lobes, and a gold necklace hanging inside it. The gold-tone Serpentine Whisper Chain lies on a wide ivory organza swatch: a smooth snake chain in a loop, with its extender and clasp, and a single clear cushion-cut stone in a four-prong setting. A fine gold thread hangs in a soft curve across the organza from one prong to a hang-tag with a wine-plum top that hangs over the swatch's edge. The tag reads Shade N° 09, matched to sweetheart, one stone, 40 cm. In italics: the moon from N° 02, at 40 cm. Below: Serpentine Whisper Chain, ₹1,299. One cushion-cut stone, about 10 mm, on a 2 mm snake chain; 40 cm, with a 5 cm extender.

An apricot tile headed [03], 40 cm plus Y: V-neck. Follow the V. Beside the heading, a small sage line drawing of a blouse with a deep V-neck, and a gold necklace with a drop that stops just above the point. A tall framed photograph shows a woman in an open ivory shirt, cropped below the chin. She wears two fine gold-tone necklaces at once: a short chain with a single marquise stone, and a Y-lariat whose small stones run down into the V of the shirt. Beside it, in italics: stop just above the point. Then: Marquise Layering Set, ₹1,599. A fine 40 cm chain with one marquise, over a Y-lariat of marquise stations. Lower down, a hang-tag with a pink top, pinned to the photo's edge, reads Shade N° 09, matched to V-neck, two necklaces, worn at once.

An apricot tile headed [04], 50 cm: Collar. Go past it. Beside the heading, a small sage line drawing of a blouse with a shirt collar, a band and two separate points, and a gold necklace falling below the gap between them. A framed photograph shows a woman's neck and collarbones, cropped below the chin. She wears the gold-tone Toggle Link Chain of long, open oval links, which falls below the base of the neck. A hang-tag with a pale sage top, pinned to the photo's edge, reads Shade N° 09, matched to collar, 50 cm, below it. In italics: a kurta or shirt collar? 50 cm falls below it. Below: Toggle Link Chain, ₹1,299. 50 cm, 4 mm links. At the foot: Send us the neckline on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935, Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm.
deviations: Cover necklace (s1): the source photo crops the Crystal necklace's tail mid-stone at its bottom edge, so at the specced 440px, with the tail ending on the organza, it read as a severed necklace. It is drawn 560 tall and 417 wide (0.53x native), centred (420,699), rotated -6deg, so the tail runs off the swatch and its cut end lies under the tape. The contact shadow sits under the loop (centre 430,724, 300 wide). The thread is tied to the gold side of the last tail baguette above the bracket, at (394,885), not about (387,855) (spec) or (386,814) (previous pass; art director's fix 6). Under the system's control-point rule (649,1103) it crosses the bracket at x438, 45px clear of the '36 CM' label, runs UNDER the tape from x464 to x566 (between the 14 and 20 numerals, never over them) and comes out below it on its way to the tag. Thread, bracket and label no longer meet in one spot.

Cover tape block 20px higher: tape y940-1004 (spec y960-1024), bracket line y922 (spec y942), '36 CM' label b910 (spec b930). The swatch is 480 tall (y380-860), not 500. At the spec position, the tape's bottom-right corner sat 4px above the rotated tag's top-left corner, a near-tangent. The gap is now 24px. Scale (2.4 px/mm), 0 at x108 and 36 at x972 are exact.

Small gold text: gold-text #80612A on apricot #F0C9AC measures 3.73:1, under the 4.5:1 the brief requires for 22-24px Jost. The cover's '36 CM' tape label, the four arc labels on s2 and the s2 index lengths are set in apricot-on #4A2B1D (8.25:1). Gold stays on the lines: the bracket, arcs, leaders, rules and threads.

s2 blouse flat (art director's fixes 1, 3, 4, 5): redrawn from the s3-s6 glyph silhouette, which is P3's sample blouse, so the one blouse keeps its shape from s2 to s6. It is P3 at 0.81 across, centred x450, with the body a little longer so the 50 cm loop clears the hem band: shoulders at (298,468)/(602,468) (SVG units; the drawing sits 25px lower on the slide), sleeves that fall close to the body to hem corners angled down and in at (236,626)/(664,626), underarms (285,646)/(615,646), P3's set-in armhole seams, a body tapering to a curved hem at x312-588 (y832-842) and P3's curved hem band 22px above it. The neck points (390/510), the round neckline's 60px dip, the inside back and the arcs are unchanged. Every sleeve corner sits 20px or more from the four leaders (rendered y570/625/695/775): outer corners 26px under the 40 cm leader, underarms 24px above the 40 cm + Y leader. The sleeve bands are removed (fix 5's second option): with the sleeve hem placed to clear the leaders, a band 14px above it came within 10px of the 40 cm leader, and the glyphs on s3-s6 carry none. Waist darts at x355/545 (apex y728, 35px clear of the 50 cm loop, 22px above its leader). The placket keeps its dashed centre front (450,510)-(450,810) with three 12px hooks at y572, 716 and 780, each 27px or more from any gold (fix 3).

s2 chart (art director's fix 2): the spec's four arcs 36 / 40 / 45 / 50 cm did not map to the priced index (36 / 40 / 40 CM + Y / 50): the 45 cm arc had no piece and the V-neck row's Y was drawn nowhere. The 45 cm arc, its leader and its label are removed. In their place, the Marquise lariat's Y drop: a 3px #C99A4C line down the centre front from the 40 cm loop's lowest point (450,600) to (450,664), ending in a pointed 7x14 marquise centred on its leader at y670, with a dotted leader from (456,670) to x750 and the label '40 CM + Y' at b678 (the old 45 cm slot). The marquise is centred on the leader rather than starting at 668, so the leader points at the stone, not its tip. The chart now maps row for row to the index. The s5 glyph's drop is redrawn with the same pointed marquise.
s2 index: the neckline column is at x248, not x230, and the length column is tracked .08em. At x230, '40 CM + Y' ended 18px from 'v-neck.'.

s3 photo: crop (200,420)-(1000,1080), drawn 760x631 (736x607 inside the border, 0.92x native) at x72-832, y370-1001, rotate -1.5deg. The spec's crop (150,400)-(1050,1250) at 760x718 showed the model's mustard camisole straps and V-neck at the bottom corners, under BOAT NECK (art director's fix 1). The new crop also drops the empty lower décolletage, so the necklace is larger. Every corner and edge was checked at 100%: skin, the studio wall at top left, no garment.

s3 text block at b1170/b1226/b1290 (spec b1180/b1236/b1300; previous pass b1210/b1266/b1330). With the shorter print, the block sits centred between the print's lowest corner (y1011) and the foot of the tile: 141px above the caps, 150px under the kicker.
s3 kicker reads 'CRYSTAL, RUBY-RED OR GREEN', not 'CRYSTAL, RUBY OR GREEN' (art director's fix 10). 'Ruby' alone names a gem, and P1 already uses the house phrasing 'ruby-red'. The alt text matches.

Neckline glyphs, s3-s6 (not in the spec; an earlier art director's fix): one small blouse flat per slide, in the same place on every slide, at x855-999, y204-318. The hem's lowest point sits on the second headline's baseline (b316), and the top stays below the y202 counter zone (collar band stroke at 202.1). They use s2's line vocabulary: 3px #3F5A4C round caps over #F4EBE2 at 70%, the inside back in s2's linen tone, and one 3px #C99A4C arc. The silhouette is P3's katori blouse at 0.265, the same blouse s2 now draws large. The four necklines: a wide, shallow boat neck with a 36 cm arc close above it; a sweetheart, two lobes meeting at a pointed notch, with a 40 cm arc inside it; a deep V with a 40 cm arc and a drop ending in a small pointed marquise just above the point; a collar band with two separate collar points, the 50 cm loop coming out below the gap between them. The arcs share one scale, shallower than s2's ellipses: at s2's proportions, a 36 cm arc hangs lower than a boat neckline sits. No type in the glyphs.

Pins and threads, s3, s5, s6: the thread is tied under the pin's head (head = point + (23,-40)), and the pin is drawn over the thread, so the head caps the thread's end. Previously the thread was tied to the pin's point and doubled back on the shaft (fix 6). s3 thread (907.12,786.18) to (847.6,693), pin point unchanged at (826.2,730.2).

s4: organza swatch x90-930 (spec x90-990) and tag unrotated y850-1114 (spec y820-1084), so the tag clearly overlaps the swatch: it runs 60px past the swatch's right edge and 40px below its foot (fix 9). No pinked teeth show beside the tag (checked at 2x). The thread is tied at the tip of the pendant's front-right prong (312,912), on the gold, not about (240,890) (spec) or over the crystal's face (previous pass). Tied at the bail, the thread ran along the snake chain and read as a second chain.

s4 turn 'the moon from N° 02, at 40 cm.' is set in lining figures (font-variant-numeric: lining-nums; fix 12). In Cormorant's old-style figures, '02' read as 'o2' beside the superscript º. The two FACT lines keep old-style figures, as text.

s5: the pin point moved down the print's right border from (591.8,1000.3) to (594.8,1118.2), and the tag's unrotated box from y1040-1304 to y1090-1354 (spec y1040-1304; rotated bottom y1363, inside the 1395 safe line). The pin head sat about 73px clear of the right column's plating line (b1000), which the 26 Oct pass removed (one plating line per carousel). The art director's 'about (594,1100)' left 68px, so the pin went 18px lower (fix 7). The tag detail breaks as 'two necklaces,' (b218) and 'worn at once' (b240) (fix 8). On one line it ran to within about 10px of the inner gold rule.
s5: the fact is broken into four lines, 'a fine 40 cm chain / with one marquise, / over a Y-lariat / of marquise stations.'. A plain 368px wrap left 'stations.' alone on the last line.

s6 photo: crop (130,236)-(786,880) of the 896px plate, drawn at its native 656x644 inside a 680x668 print (x72-752, y378-1046), rotate +1deg. The spec's crop was (60,230)-(836,896) at 860x738: 1.11x the plate's own pixels, with the white studio wall at its left. The previous pass's (130,236)-(828,896) showed the mustard camisole strap at the bottom right, under COLLAR (fix 1). The strap now sits about 30px outside the crop.

s6 interior tag (spec: 'No tag on this slide'; added by fix 3, because the narrower print left the right column empty): s3's position, unrotated x800-992, y760-1024, rotate +6deg, scale .8, pale sage chip #E3EAE1 with a 1px #3F5A4C edge, 'COLLAR' / '50 cm, below it'. The pin sits on the print's right border at (745.6,738.8), not at the art director's '(797,740)'. Fix 1's narrower crop moves the print's right edge from x794 to x752, so the tag hangs 48px clear of the print, joined to it by the thread. The WhatsApp footer is unchanged.

s6 counter fallback (s06-fallback) is rebuilt from the fixed s06 (crop, glyph, COLLAR tag). Only its footer differs: 'TELL US WHO IT’S FOR AND YOUR BUDGET' / 'WHATSAPP +91 95615 57935'. The second line names the channel because the first does not.
Caption, paragraph 2: 'four necklines, four pieces', not the spec's 'four necklines, four lengths'. The pieces sit at 36, 40, 40 + Y and 50 cm, which is three lengths.

s6 collar glyph (art director's fix 8): the two collar points crossed at centre front in an X, which read as a bow. They are now two separate points hanging from the band, each angled down and out (tips at local (48.5,33) and (101.5,33)), their tops tucked under the band with a gap of about 11px between them at centre front (local x 69-81 at the band's lower edge, at 0.96). The 50 cm loop runs under each point and comes out below the gap, its lowest point on the centre front. Checked at 1x (144px wide) beside the boat, sweetheart and V glyphs, and at 2.8x: it reads as a shirt collar.

Prints s3, s5, s6 and both s6 fallbacks (art director's fix 7): a 1px inner keyline, rgba(74,43,29,.20), where the photo meets its 12px #FBF3EC border (.a-print::after, inset box-shadow). On s3 the near-white studio wall at the print's top left no longer merges with the border. The wall itself is not retouched.

s4 tag (art director's fix 10): 'SWEETHEART' in Velista 27px (was 30), one line, same baseline (y170 in the tag). Measured clearance to the inner gold rule: 22 tag units each side, 18px on the canvas at the tag's 0.8 scale (was about 13 / 10.5). The other names (BOAT / NECK, V-NECK, COLLAR) clear it by 34px or more on the canvas; at 27px SWEETHEART is still the tag's widest name and stays legible beside them.

s6 still-life fallback built (s06-still.html/.jpg/-45.jpg/-thumb.png) for the art director's fix 9: assets/shopify/toggle-link-chain/01.jpg, the chain on the plaster block, in s6's frame, crop (220,400)-(1000,1166) at 0.84x native, clear of the grey sweep at the plate's top left; headline, tag, turn, fact and footer unchanged, so 'GO PAST IT.' and '50 cm falls below it.' rest on the listing and size guide only. Alt text if used: "An apricot tile headed [04], 50 cm: Collar. Go past it. Beside the heading, a small sage line drawing of a blouse with a shirt collar, a band and two separate points, and a gold necklace falling below the gap between them. A framed photograph shows the gold-tone Toggle Link Chain of long, open oval links draped over a white plaster block, its round ring hanging at the front. A hang-tag with a pale sage top, pinned to the photo's edge, reads Shade N° 09, matched to collar, 50 cm, below it. In italics: a kurta or shirt collar? 50 cm falls below it. Below: Toggle Link Chain, ₹1,299. 50 cm, 4 mm links. At the foot: Send us the neckline on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935, Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm."

Grid-director pass (26 Oct), s1 tag chip #F0C9AC with no edge (was #FBF3EC with the #E3D9CE edge): shade N° 09's own apricot, the same logic as P2, P10 and P11, which carry their ground's colour. An ivory chip on ivory paper stayed invisible even inside the system's new inset window (fix 1). svg/tag-p09.svg matches (build_svgs.cjs).

Grid-director pass, one plating line per carousel (system README §3, fix 7): s2's index already states '[ 18K GOLD TONE PLATED ]' for all four lengths, so s3's kicker reads '[ CRYSTAL, RUBY-RED OR GREEN ]' (was '[ 18K GOLD TONE PLATED · CRYSTAL, RUBY-RED OR GREEN ]') and the plating line is deleted on s4 (b1366) and s5 (b1000, right column). The four pieces are all listed '18k Gold Tone Plated' (research/roster.json). Alt texts for s3-s5 updated to match.

Grid-director pass, system fixes 1 and 4: every interior tag (s3-s6 and the s6 variants) shows its chip as the inset window (the COLLAR tag's #3F5A4C edge is now an outline round it); the s1 and s4 organza swatches (540 and 840 wide) take the two soft sheen bands, a change of 1-3 levels on ivory.

ECD pass (26 Oct), SF1, the two-line footer form: 'BAGUETTE TENNIS NECKLACE, CRYSTAL' is a-foot (20px .28em) at b1302 (was a-label 20px b1300) and '₹2,300' is a-price 20px .28em at b1352 (was 24px b1350), both apricot-on. Nothing else: 36 CM. stays the strongest type tile on the grid, and after the P11 / P12 fixes its ivory swatch is the only large one in the top two rows (P8's 210 px [04] chip, ivory with a ruby band, is flagged to the director). Alt text and caption unchanged.

s04 thread (grid-director fix, 26 Oct): data-ctrl="610,1000" on the thread from the pendant (312,912) to the tag (907.12,876.18), a ~50px sag. With the default control point (~14px of sag over 595px) it ran almost straight across the organza and read as a wire; it now hangs below the chain's lower arc and stays on the swatch. No cover change: 36 CM., the tape, the bracket and the tag read at thumbnail size. SF1 maker's mark (system, 26 Oct): every non-mini tag now carries the flower as a crisp 18x26 blush mark at (111,286) in the tag's lower third, 8px above the inner gold rule, instead of the 62x90 ghost at 12% behind the second name line and the detail (read as a pink smudge at 100%).
checks: Prices = research/roster.json today (re-read 26 Oct 2026, file dated 25 Oct): Baguette Tennis Necklace ₹2,300 (stock 70, no compare-at), Serpentine Whisper Chain ₹1,299 (20), Marquise Layering Set ₹1,599 (40), Toggle Link Chain ₹1,299 (79). The caption's range '₹1,299 to ₹2,300' matches. No piece is at 1-5 units. No code, percentage, struck MRP or date appears on any slide. The offer is in the caption only, and the bag applies one code. Re-read Shopify the morning of 15 Nov and the evening before.

Claims: every piece is tagged 18k Gold Tone Plated, so the images say 'gold tone' only, never bare 'gold'. The stones say only 'cushion-cut stone', 'baguettes' and 'marquise'. The variant line reads 'CRYSTAL, RUBY-RED OR GREEN', never ruby alone or emerald. Lengths and widths come only from the listings and the size guide: 36 cm; 40 cm + 5 cm extender, 2 mm snake, about 10 mm stone; 40 cm chain + Y-lariat; 50 cm, 4 mm. 'give or take 1 cm' is the size guide's own line. The glyphs' arcs are schematic, like s2's, and carry no numbers. The Toggle's clasp is not described anywhere, including the alt text. There is no waterproof, tarnish or hypoallergenic claim, and the cover's tape makes no same-scale claim.

Garments in the worn plates: s3 and s6 crops checked at 100% at every corner and along every edge, in the source and in the render. There is no mustard camisole anywhere: skin, hair, and the studio wall at s3's top left only. A hue and saturation mask also finds no garment pixels (s6's 12 hits are the gold chain). Plates are Higgsfield plates already live on the PDPs, all cropped below the lips.

Copy: no em or en dashes, exclamation marks, emoji or urgency in any slide, the caption or the first comment. Middots appear only in Jost lines. Velista carries only A-Z, digits, '.', '-'. Turns are lowercase and end with a full stop. The tag details 'two necklaces, / worn at once' and '50 cm, below it' are Cormorant italic within the tag's 200px measure. The call-back 'the moon from N° 02, at 40 cm.' is on s4.

Scripts: the one non-Latin string, माप (U+092E U+093E U+092A), is unchanged on s1 and matches the spec byte for byte. It shapes correctly in Tiro Devanagari Marathi. It still needs the named Marathi reader's sign-off with the other Option A Marathi strings.

Resolution (final 1080px, measured in Chromium): Crystal necklace cut-out 787x1056 shown 417x560 (0.53x). Serpentine cut-out 960x712 at 640x475 (0.67x). s3 plate crop 800px wide at 736 (0.92x). s5 plate crop 900 at 496 (0.56x). s6 plate crop 656 at 656 (1.00x). s6 still-life fallback crop 780 at 656 (0.84x). Nothing is shown above native size; printCrop warns if it would be.

Safe areas (measured): the s1 top-right is plain ground. Glyphs sit at x855-999 and y203.6-316.7 (geometry), with strokes from y202.1, clear of the x>=907, y<=202 counter zone. Tags: s1 cover position unchanged (hole 904,1073). s3 and s6 rotated box x787-1005, y751-1033. s4 x787-1005, y841-1123. s5 x747-965, y1081-1363. All critical content is within y45-1395, and no type runs outside x72-1008. Every -45.jpg crop keeps every word, glyph and tag.

Craft: s1 thread is tied to a gold setting edge (394,885), crosses the bracket at x438, 45px clear of the '36 CM' label, and lies under the tape. s2: sleeves fall close to the body; every sleeve corner is 24px or more from a leader; no sleeve band; hooks 27px or more from any gold; dart apexes 35px from the 50 cm loop; the Y drop's marquise sits on its leader. s3, s5 and s6 threads hang from under the pin heads, with no kink, and each print has its inner keyline. On s4 the tag overlaps the swatch with no tangent and no stray teeth. Each glyph was viewed at 2x and at 1x: all four read as distinct necklines in the same frame, the collar as two points with a gap, and the swipe from s2 (same blouse, large) to s3-s6 reads as one series.

Contrast (WCAG, against the ground hex): apricot-on #4A2B1D on apricot 8.25:1. The tape's ink on cream is above 15:1. The tag's warm grey on paper is about 5.9:1. Gold #C99A4C is used only for lines, threads and the glyph arcs, never for text.

Grid: s01-thumb (391x521) reads 36 CM., the crystal necklace on organza, the tape and the SHADE N° 09 tag. gridcheck.png is rebuilt with this cover (row 2, beside P8 and P7). Every -45.jpg crop keeps every word, glyph and tag, on all six slides and both s6 fallbacks.

If the owner cannot staff WhatsApp Mon to Sat, 10-7, post it instead of s06 and change the first comment to 'Tell us who it is for and your budget on WhatsApp, +91 95615 57935. We will send back three options with photographs.' The owner has NOT confirmed the counter yet.

On it the 50 cm chain ends just below the collarbones, only a little lower than s3's 36 cm, and the caption says 'measured, not guessed'. Ask the owner whether the plate shows the true 50 cm drop. If yes, post s06 (or s06-fallback). If not, post s06-still.jpg (the specced still-life fallback, 01.jpg) in its place, with its alt text from the deviations; 'GO PAST IT.' and '50 cm falls below it.' then stand as size-guide claims only. If both the counter and the plate fail, swap s06-still's footer for s06-fallback's two lines (one edit, then re-render).
